csv_project_name: Engineering for E-18 Bridge Deck Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Professional Engineering Services Regarding the Design for the Deck Replacement on Bridge E-18 on County Route 33 (Seven Bridges Road) over Parkers Creek in the Borough of Oceanport, Monmouth County. The intent of this Request for Professional Qualifications is to select three (3) leading consulting firm candidates to provide Professional Engineering Services for development of final construction documents and obtaining all regulatory permits and approvals for the removal of the E-18 Bridge deck and complete rehabilitation of steel girders, bearings, and other necessary repairs to extend the serviceable lifespan of the bridge
